text: The module exports `formatParlor` and `isEligible` in addition to `run`, so it does not export exactly one entry point and does not do one thing. The specification requires a service module to export exactly one entry point (a function named `run`) and states that if a service grows a second responsibility it becomes a second service. The email-rendering responsibility (`formatParlor`) and the loyalty-eligibility responsibility (`isEligible`) must be moved into their own service modules, leaving this file with only `run`.
